title: This beaten-down retailer just surged 35%. Jim Cramer says to pounce on the next pullback
raw_text:
Key Points
- CNBC's Jim Cramer said Thursday Abercrombie & Fitch still looks attractive, though he'd wait for the shares to cool off before buying.
- "Abercrombie & Fitch might need some time to digest yesterday's gains, but I think Fran Horowitz is doing an incredible job here, and if the stock gives you a pullback, you might want to pounce," the "Mad Money" host said.
